edit.statement: All else equal, that transmitted rate rise tends to increase interest-sensitive expenditure.
edit.subject: A policy-rate rise transmitted to borrowing rates
edit.original: All else equal, a policy-rate rise transmitted to borrowing rates tends to decrease interest-sensitive expenditure.
edit.scope: General conditional tendency under transmission and ceteris paribus conditions; no guaranteed magnitude or observed historical macroeconomic outcome.

direct.prompt: All else equal, when a policy-rate rise reaches borrowing rates, in what direction does interest-sensitive expenditure tend to move?

paraphrase.prompt: With other influences fixed and borrowing-rate transmission present, does monetary tightening tend to raise or reduce interest-sensitive expenditure?

cross_lingual.prompt: 其他因素不变且政策利率上升传导至借款利率时，利率敏感支出倾向于朝哪个方向变化？
Manteniendo constantes los demás factores y transmitiéndose la subida del tipo oficial a los tipos de préstamo, ¿en qué dirección tiende a moverse el gasto sensible a los intereses?

derived.prompt: Economy E has the specified transmission and no other changing influences. Its policy rate rises. What direction of interest-sensitive expenditure is predicted?
In E, all expenditure is interest-sensitive and the rule’s conditions hold. Its policy rate rises. What direction of total expenditure is predicted?
bridge: In E, all expenditure is interest-sensitive.

derived.prompt: Firm F’s planned investment is interest-sensitive, all other influences stay fixed, and borrowing rates rise through policy transmission. What directional tendency applies to its investment?
The policy rate rises but borrowing rates do not respond. Using only the transmitted-rate mechanism, in which direction does interest-sensitive expenditure move?
